reason: Check journal uniqueness, fail-closed recovery, explicit reconcile transition, and evidence preservation.
Check one top-level guard, no self-deadlock, same-target serialization, and different-target availability.
Check typed stable codes and absence of string-based control flow or raw command rejections.
Check manifests, paths, credentials, URLs, fingerprints, and raw errors never reach logs or IPC.
Check desktop and CLI share the guarded installation and recovery service APIs.
Check confirmation, blocker, retry, stale-response, and localized error behavior.
Check command registry, typed map, fixtures, generated parity, and store invocation boundaries.
Check focused regression placement and coverage at real service/command/UI seams.
Check locked Rust gates, frontend gates, generated docs/contracts, and final just ci.
Check implementation against the exact live symptom and confirmed root-cause chain.
